verdicts.reason: A keeps the three plan cards and the CTA in one readable left-to-right row, but the subhead is squeezed into a narrow left column that wraps one or two words per line, and the YEARLY card shrinks smaller than the other two, which reverses the original's emphasis; the oversized headline also crowds the logo, and the legal text is unreadably small. B breaks the plan set apart: the FAMILY card floats on its own at the far right at a different height, the MONTHLY and YEARLY cards sit jammed under the subhead and against the left edge, the CTA and legal text are wedged into the bottom middle, and the top-right is left empty, so B has no coherent structure.
